name: /lvl rank
description: Displays your current XP, level, and rank on a personalized rank card.
notes: Includes your profile picture, username, XP progress, and overall server rank. Only works in enabled channels.
examples: I want to see my rank
How much XP do I have?

name: /lvl leaderboard
description: Displays the top users in the server by XP or level on a visual leaderboard card.
notes: Shows avatars, usernames, levels, and XP for the top 10 users. Voice XP is also counted if enabled.
examples: Can I see the XP board?

name: /ga start
description: Starts a new giveaway with customizable prize, duration, winner count, and more.
notes: Supports optional image, level/role requirements, and host tag. Duration format like `1h`, `30m`, etc.
examples: How do I make a giveaway?

name: /ga reroll
description: Selects a new winner for a completed giveaway.
notes: Giveaway ID can be copied from the message footer or fetched via `/ga list`.

name: /ga list
description: Displays all active giveaways running in the server.
notes: Lists prize names, remaining time, and host for each ongoing giveaway.

name: /ga entries
description: Shows all giveaways a specific user has entered.
notes: You can check for yourself or another member. Useful for verifying eligibility.
examples: What giveaways did I participate in?

name: /ga wins
description: Lists all giveaways a user has won in the past.
notes: Helpful for tracking frequent winners and celebrating past prizes!

name: /gq submit
description: Submit proof of your completed Guild Quest to earn participation credit.
notes: You can submit for yourself or on behalf of another user. Attach a valid screenshot showing completion.
examples: How do I submit a guild quest?
I want to send quest proof

name: /gq dm-notif
description: Enable or disable direct message notifications for Guild Quest submission updates.
notes: You can toggle for yourself or another user if you're an admin.
examples: Turn on DMs for guild quests
Stop getting messages about quest rewards

name: /gq stats
aliases: how many quests have I done
description: Displays your Guild Quest statistics, including rewarded, rejected, and pending submissions.
notes: You can check your own stats or someone else’s.

name: /gq pending
description: Lists all your Guild Quest submissions that are currently under review.
notes: Shows timestamps and images if available.

name: /gq rewarded
description: Displays all approved and rewarded Guild Quest submissions.
notes: Includes dates, quest types, and reward values if available.
examples: What quests did I get rewarded for?

name: /gq rejected
description: View all rejected Guild Quest submissions and reasons if available.
notes: Helps you improve future submissions.

name: /gq find
description: Find a specific Guild Quest submission using its unique ID.
notes: Helpful for references or inquiries.
examples: Can you show me gq ID 209?

name: /gq leaderboard
description: Displays the top users ranked by rewarded Guild Quest submissions.
notes: Encourages healthy competition among guildmates.

name: /gq delete
description: Deletes a pending Guild Quest submission using its ID.
notes: Only works for unreviewed submissions.
examples: Cancel my last guild quest submission

name: /mz submit
description: Initiate a Guild Maze submission with a start and end floor. A thread will be created for you to upload proof.
notes: Submit for yourself or another user. Attach proof in the created thread.
examples: How do I submit a maze?
I want to upload maze proof

name: /mz dm-notif
description: Enable or disable DM notifications for maze submission updates.
notes: Helps you stay updated on your maze rewards or rejections.

name: /mz stats
description: Shows your total maze submissions, rewarded floors, rejections, and more.
notes: Breakdown by floor ranges and approval status.
examples: How many floors did I clear?

name: /mz pending
description: Lists all maze submissions that are currently waiting for review.
notes: Submission details may be visible in their respective threads.
examples: What maze/mazes is still in review?

name: /mz rewarded
description: Displays a list of all approved and rewarded maze submissions.
notes: Includes floor ranges, dates, and total rewarded floors.

name: /mz rejected
description: View all rejected maze submissions and rejection reasons.
notes: Useful for learning from past mistakes and avoiding repeated issues.

name: /mz find
description: Find a specific maze submission by its unique ID.
notes: Helpful when following up on a review or issue.

name: /mz leaderboard
description: Shows the top users by total rewarded floors in the Guild Maze.
notes: Encourages friendly competition between maze runners.

name: /mz delete
description: Deletes a pending maze submission by ID.
notes: Only works for unreviewed submissions. Useful if you made a mistake.
